_comment: Absolute totals for Palworld 1.0 progression categories.
Save files record only what a player has OBTAINED, so a save can never tell
you how much is left. These are published figures used as denominators, with
the cross-server union as a fallback for anything not listed.
Validated directly against a real 1.0 save:
CAUTION on observation-based validation: towerBosses was briefly set to 7
because that matched the most-advanced player's defeated count. That was a
coincidence — 1.0 has 9 towers (Auri & Shaolong and Zenara & Astralym were
added), and the player simply had not beaten the last two. A save can only
ever show a lower bound, so agreement with observation never confirms a
total. Prefer published figures, and treat matches as unproven.
paldeck comes from the bundled pal database (299 entries), which is derived
from the game's own tables and is authoritative.
If a figure here is ever lower than what a player has actually obtained, the
code falls back to the observed value, so a stale number can never produce a

_confidence.towerBosses: high — 1.0 list enumerated in full (Zoe, Lily, Axel, Marcus, Victor, Saya, Bjorn, Auri, Zenara)
_confidence.paldeck: high — matches the bundled pal database derived from game tables
_confidence.dungeons: high — matches DungeonPointMarkerSaveData in a real save
_confidence.effigies: medium — counts Pal Effigies including variants, not just Lifmunk
_confidence.sealedRealms: medium — not cross-checked against a save
